answer: Give every identity a score that only grows through verified, useful work and rots when idle, so a hollow army of parked fakes decays to zero before it can strike. A fable of effortless duplication fails because the ledger counts completed tasks, not registered names. The jetty into paid work is guarded by this score: new agents enter slowly, prove themselves, and only then earn, while a sybil that never works simply fades away.
